objectives.description: Introduction: definition of commerce and e-commerce; history/background of commerce; scope of commerce and e-commerce; functions of commerce and e-commerce.
Occupation: meaning of occupation; types — industrial, commercial, service; factors that determine types of occupation/employment; career opportunities.

Production: meaning; factors — land, labour, capital and entrepreneurship; types — primary, secondary and tertiary production; division of labour/specialization — meaning, types, advantages and disadvantages, limitation; inter-relationship between production and exchange.

subStrands.name: Forms of Business and Trade Bodies

objectives.description: Business units: meaning and objectives of business; forms of business units — sole proprietorship, partnership, co-operative societies, credit union and thrift societies, public enterprises, companies; types, formation, characteristics, comparison, advantages and disadvantages; sources of capital of each form.
Amalgamations, mergers and acquisitions, trusts, holding companies and subsidiaries, consortium and cartel; dissolution/liquidation of companies/partnerships.
Trade associations: aims and functions of trade associations, chamber of commerce, employers' associations; consumer association/consumerism.

subStrands.name: Capital, Credit, Profits, Home Trade and Foreign Trade

objectives.description: Business capital and profits: meaning and types — authorized/registered/nominal capital, called-up, paid-up capital, capital owned, liquid/circulating capital; credit — meaning, sources, instruments and functions; calculation of working capital and its importance; profits — meaning, types and calculation; turnover — meaning, calculations and factors affecting turnover.

Home trade — retail trade: functions of retailer; factors to consider in starting a retail business; reasons for success/failure of retail business; small scale and large scale retailing — unit shops, stalls, hawkers, kiosks, mobile shops, supermarket, chain stores, department stores, shopping malls, hypermarkets and mail order business; modern trends in retailing — branding, self-service, vouchers, vending machines, credit cards.

Wholesale trade: functions of wholesalers, types of wholesalers — merchant and agent wholesalers; factors making for elimination and survival of middlemen; channels of distribution — meaning, types and factors for choice.

Foreign trade: meaning, types (import, export and entreport); basic concepts — terms of trade, balance of trade, balance of payment (favourable, unfavourable, visible and invisible items), bilateral and multilateral agreements and counter trade; advantages and disadvantages; barriers to foreign trade; tariffs — meaning and reasons for tariffs; functions of port and airports authorities, customs and excise authority and shipping, clearing and forwarding agents, exports promotion council.

strands.name: Purchase and Sale Documents and Payment

subStrands.name: Trade Documents, Price Quotations and Payment Methods

objectives.description: Procedure and documents used in business: order, indent, consular invoice, ordinary invoice, credit/debit notes, proforma invoice, letter of hypothecation, documentary credit, certificate of origin, certificate of inspection, insurance certificate.
Price quotation: trade discount, cash discount, quantity discount, COD, CWO, CIF, FOB, E & OE, ex-works, LOCO, FAS, FOR and Franco.

Terms of payment: cash/spot payment, purchase and deferred payment; means of payment — legal tender (bank notes and coins), cheques, standing order, bank draft, stamps, postal orders, money orders, bills of exchange and promissory note, mail transfer, traveller's cheques, telegraphic transfer, e-payment.

subStrands.name: Money, Banks, Insurance, Capital Market, Stock Exchange and Commodity Exchange

objectives.description: Money: meaning, evolution/history, forms, qualities and functions.

Banks: types — central bank, commercial banks and other specialized banks e.g. development bank, mortgage bank, building society, micro finance institutions; bureau-de-change — meaning and functions; e-banking — meaning, forms (ATM, money transfer, e-payment, online transfer); types of accounts — current, savings and fixed deposit.

Insurance: meaning and basic principles — utmost good faith, insurable interest, indemnity and subrogation, contribution and proximate cause; types — life insurance (whole life assurance, endowment) and non-life insurance (motor vehicle, fire, fidelity, burglary/robbery/theft, accidents, consequential loss, marine); types of risk (insurable and uninsurable); importance of insurance; procedure for taking an insurance policy; underwriting and re-insurance.
Capital market: meaning and functions; methods of raising funds by companies — offer for sale, offer for subscription, rights issue, private placement, issue by tender; second tier security market.

Stock exchange: meaning and functions; importance; transactions on the stock exchange; speculators — meaning and types; types of security — shares, stock, bond gilt edge, debentures/convertible loans.

Commodity exchange: meaning; types of tradable commodities; requirements for trading — grading, standardizing, warehousing, clearing system; methods of trading — open outcry and electronic mechanisms; benefits of commodity exchange.
Transport: meaning, importance, choice of transport; forms — land, water, air, pipeline; advantages and disadvantages of each form; documents — waybills, consignment note, tickets and manifest.

Communication: meaning; types — oral, written, visual, non-verbal, non-visual, traditional; advantages and disadvantages; importance and services of post office; courier agencies and other communication agencies — telephone system, satellite services, internet/email; computer appreciation — meaning, component parts, advantages and disadvantages.
Tourism: meaning, importance, functions, types, advantages.
Warehousing: meaning, importance, functions, types, advantages.

subStrands.name: Advertising, Marketing, Customer Services, Sales Promotion and Business Law

objectives.description: Advertising: meaning; roles, advantages and disadvantages; types — informative, persuasive, competitive, mass/specific; methods — direct and indirect; media — meaning, choice and types.

Marketing: meaning, importance, functions; differences between market and marketing; market and marketing research; the marketing mix (4Ps — product, price, place and promotion); marketing concept — meaning, components.
Customer services: meaning, importance, types — pre and after sales services.
Sales promotion: meaning, methods — trade fairs, exhibitions, gifts, demonstration, personal selling; meaning and importance.

Legal aspects of business: contract — meaning, elements of a valid contract, discharge of a contract; agency — meaning, creation, duties and responsibilities of principals and agents, termination; sales of goods act; hire purchase act; rights and obligations of employer and employee; government regulation of business — patents, copyright, trade mark; registration of business.

Consumer protection: meaning and need for protection; means of protection; consumerism — means and instruments of protection; government legislation — food and drugs act, standard organization act, price control act, factory/shops and offices act, product quality.

subStrands.name: Business Management, Government Policies and Economic Groupings

objectives.description: Introduction to business management: meaning and objectives of business; meaning of business management; functions; business resources — man, money, materials, opportunities/goodwill; structure of business organizational setup — organisational chart, departments, functions, authority, delegation of authority, responsibility, span of control.
Business environment: economical, political, competition, technological etc.; social responsibility of business to the society; importance of inter and intra departmental communications.
Government policies relating to business: commercialisation, privatisation, deregulation — meaning, reasons, advantages and disadvantages, comparison/differences.

Economic groupings: ECOWAS, Niger Basin Commission (NBC), Lake Chad Basin Commission (LCBC), Mano-River Union, European Union, West African Clearing House — history, membership, objectives, achievements, problems/obstacles.
